draft.narrative: This Q1 summary covers 300 students and checks two areas: attendance and academics. Behavior was not in the files, so it was not checked and nothing is reported for it. Attendance uses a chronic absence rule of missing 10% or more of scheduled days, and 63 students (21%) were flagged. Academics uses an unweighted GPA below 2.00, or 1 or more failing course grade when course grades are in the file, and 36 students (12%) were flagged. 23 students (8%) were flagged in both areas. By tier, 224 students (75%) are in Tier 1, 53 (18%) are in Tier 2, and 23 (8%) are in Tier 3. In grade 9, with 78 students, 20 (26%) were flagged for attendance and 13 (17%) for academics. In grade 12, with 70 students, 19 (27%) were flagged for attendance and 10 (14%) for academics. In grade 10, the attendance count is not shown, to protect small counts, and the academics count is fewer than 10. In grade 11, both counts are fewer than 10. No earlier snapshot was provided, so no change over time is described.
